props.gloss_en: the mishnah: a Kuti is included in a zimmun
the baraita: an am haaretz is not included in a zimmun
Abaye: [the mishnah speaks] of a Kuti who is a chaver
Rava: even if you say [the mishnah speaks of] a Kuti who is an am haaretz, here [the baraita] deals with an am haaretz as the Rabbis who disagree with R' Meir [define him]
R' Meir: an am haaretz is whoever does not eat his non-sacred food in purity
the Sages: an am haaretz is whoever does not tithe his produce properly
Rava: and these Kutim tithe properly
Rava: for in what is written in the Torah they are scrupulous
the master: any mitzva the Kutim have embraced, they are far more exacting in it than Israel
R' Eliezer: an am haaretz is whoever does not recite the Shema evening and morning
R' Yehoshua: whoever does not put on tefillin
Ben Azzai: whoever has no tzitzit on his garment
R' Natan: whoever has no mezuza on his doorway
R' Natan bar Yosef: whoever has sons and does not raise them to Torah study
Acherim: even if he read [Scripture] and studied [Mishnah] but did not serve Torah scholars, he is an am haaretz
Rav Huna: the halakha follows Acherim
Rami bar Chama did not include Rav Menashya bar Tachlifa, who studied Sifra, Sifrei and halakhot, in a zimmun
Rava: Rami bar Chama died only because he did not include Rav Menashya bar Tachlifa in a zimmun
Rav Menashya bar Tachlifa is different, for he served the Rabbis
and it was Rami bar Chama who did not check after him
one who hears teachings from the mouths of the Rabbis and studies them is like a young Torah scholar

supports.gloss_en: דתניא: ...וחכמים אומרים כל שאינו מעשר פירותיו כראוי -- the Rabbis who disagree with R' Meir define the am haaretz by tithing
דבמאי דכתיב באורייתא מזהר זהירי -- they tithe properly because they are scrupulous in what is written in the Torah
דאמר מר: כל מצוה שהחזיקו בה כותים הרבה מדקדקין בה יותר מישראל

objections.gloss_en: אמאי? לא יהא אלא עם הארץ! ותניא: אין מזמנין על עם הארץ -- why is a Kuti included? let him be no more than an am haaretz, and it was taught that an am haaretz is not included

answered_by.gloss_en: בכותי חבר -- the mishnah speaks of a Kuti who is a chaver (= p_abaye_kuti_chaver)
אפילו תימא בכותי עם הארץ -- the baraita's am haaretz is the Rabbis' (one who does not tithe properly), and these Kutim tithe properly (= p_rava_am_haaretz_derabbanan, p_kutim_measrim)

objections.gloss_en: והתניא: אחרים אומרים אפילו קרא ושנה ולא שמש תלמידי חכמים הרי זה עם הארץ -- one who only studied is an am haaretz, whom one does not include

answered_by.gloss_en: שאני רב מנשיא בר תחליפא דמשמע להו לרבנן, ורמי בר חמא הוא דלא דק אבתריה -- he did serve the Rabbis; Rami bar Chama failed to check (= p_menashya_meshamesh, p_rami_lo_dak)
לישנא אחרינא: דשמע שמעתתא מפומייהו דרבנן וגריס להו -- כצורבא מרבנן דמי (= p_shama_ugares_tzurva)
